test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'includes'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• leave out- fail to include someone or something..
 
• omit- to not include something; to leave something out.
 
• excludes- to leave out; not include.
 
• includes- to have as one part; to contain (among other things)
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 1 is 'includes'.
 
• Thus, 'option 4' is the correct answer.

​

Correct sentence: *A broad definition of wetlands **includes**__ ecosystems such as lakes and rivers, underground aquifers, swamps, coral reefs, and many others.*
